move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

Your earlier capacity messages link additional allocation directly to firm commitment—it sounds like planning certainty is central to making more capacity available. We are ready to commit long-term if you can secure our full requirement on a sustainable basis. How can we turn that commitment into dependable allocation and a delivery schedule you can reliably support?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month contract and an annual volume of 23,400 units. 

In consideration of these terms and the 56-day lead time, we revise our offer to EUR 31.50 per unit. Our offer stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that our current capacity utilization is exceptionally high, which restricts further commercial adjustments. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You repeat the lead time and link limited commercial flexibility to exceptionally high utilisation; it sounds like protecting a workable production schedule is central for you. We are ready to commit firmly for the long term in return for dependable allocation of our full requirement. How can we translate that planning certainty into a sustainable agreement that secures capacity for us?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.11 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have verified the labor cost index data you provided and adjusted our calculation accordingly. Your commitment to a 36-month contract provides the planning certainty required to secure capacity for your full requirement.

In response, we revise our offer to a price of €31.20 per unit. Our offer stands for a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months, and our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
